rules.topic: Be kind, stay on topic, no replay logs over 1 MB in chat

messages.author: admin
messages.text: 1. Be kind. 2. Search #atlas-help before asking. 3. Post replay logs as a gist, not inline. 4. Mods (green) can move threads.

atlas-help.topic: Replay diverging? Start with your own HashMaps.

messages.author: mkowalski
messages.text: My replay diverges after about 200 ticks. Anything obvious?

messages.author: praman
messages.text: Nine times in ten it is an unordered map somewhere in your own code. Same bug we hit: http://github.com/northstar/atlas/issues/14

messages.author: jlee
messages.text: Is there a way to diff two checkpoints? Mine hash differently and I cannot see where.

messages.author: bob
messages.text: Fork both from one checkpoint and compare state_hash() every tick; the first tick that differs names the service :pushpin:

determinism.topic: Seeds, ticks, hashes and why your clock is lying to you

messages.author: praman
messages.text: Sort before you iterate: http://github.com/gist/bfs-order

messages.author: carol
messages.text: And never read the wall clock. Every timestamp in Atlas is a tick for a reason.

messages.author: alice
messages.text: Worth reading Priya on the general case: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/t-4411

messages.text: Moved three replay-log pastes out of #atlas-help to gists. Reminder posted in #rules.
